_status_note: Owner decisions of 2026-09-14 are applied. Still PROPOSED, therefore not binding: registration sets status REGISTERED with a future effective_utc, the registration timestamp and the code commit, then `mercer_dev.py register` logs the SHA-256 and the file is frozen. Nothing before effective_utc is ever recorded in this cohort (no backfill).
change_control: New version for any change to selection source, features, model use, market blending, eligibility, edge or divergence thresholds, markets, sizing, exposure, approval or data-quality rules. Clerical amendments are separate logged files and may not touch methodology fields. No version is ever applied retroactively.
data_sources: The Odds API v4 event odds (h2h, spreads, totals; US region; Tier-1 books)
ESPN scoreboard (event identity, schedule, status, finals)
Open Ledger football moneyline captures (data/football/odds) for closing moneyline CLV
Human research notes under the D.J. Mercer byline (injury reports, depth charts, news)

feature_definitions.confidence: standard | strong | spotlight; an ordering, never a probability, never changes stake
feature_definitions.edge_pts: 100 * (reference_probability - market_implied_probability); usually <= 0, published as it is, never described as an edge claim
feature_definitions.market_implied_probability: implied probability of the American price taken
feature_definitions.reference_probability: median over fresh Tier-1 books quoting the same number of p_side/(p_side+p_other), implied from American odds

featured_selection.rule: When the weekly featured Spotlight pick is in this sport it IS a play in this cohort: the pick carries cohort_play_id, the artifact carries featured=true and the Spotlight link, it is released only through the approved path, and it is recorded and graded ONLY in this cohort's ledger. The Spotlight ledger never books it.
featured_selection.source: D.J. Mercer Spotlight, the weekly premium featured selection
featured_selection.volume: no guaranteed number of plays or featured selections

historical_research: NFL model research continues separately and does not select or size plays. The 2026-09-14 development evaluation (docs/MERCER_DEVELOPMENTAL_PROTOCOL.md; train 2022-23, validation 2024, both previously scored) found no independent edge: best blend weight 0, and its fixed rule selected 0 plays in 800 games.
known_limitations: No demonstrated model edge; plays are human judgement supported by market and analytical data.
No record of this process exists before effective_utc, and none is backfilled.
CLV is unavailable for spreads and totals and for moneylines without a close enough capture.
Per-market timestamps depend on the provider; missing ones block release.
Sample sizes for any performance reading will be small for a long time.

manual_review.approval_binds: the full SHA-256 of the sealed artifact, which contains the exact Discord payload
manual_review.approver: Daniel, by GitHub login on MERCER_DEV_APPROVERS
manual_review.period: every play, with no end date in this version; removing it is a new version

max_market_divergence.note: no model disagreement exists; divergence is controlled as price vs consensus (3.0 pts admits an ordinary -110/-110 number, 2.38 pts below fair) and the recorded walk-away boundary

metric_availability.calibration: reference probability against results - this describes the market reference, not a model
metric_availability.clv_moneyline: only when an existing pregame capture of the event within 6 hours of kickoff has at least 3 fresh Tier-1 books; otherwise marked unavailable with the reason
metric_availability.clv_spread_total: unavailable: spreads and totals have no closing capture
metric_availability.results_units_roi: every graded play (price taken and flat stake are in the artifact)

model_type: none. No predictive model selects plays, and none is claimed. The recorded reference probability is the proportionally de-vigged median Tier-1 market consensus at the exact number at selection time.
selection_source: Human-researched selections by D.J. Mercer, supported by market data (Tier-1 consensus, price and line movement, book coverage) and analytical context (public efficiency, schedule and personnel information). Research follows docs/MERCER_SPOTLIGHT.md sections 2b-2c: the independent-case rule, a required case against, and a walk-away boundary recorded before the price is checked. No model selects, ranks or sizes plays.

selection_time.note: the artifact is built from a quote no older than max_quote_age_minutes and every check is repeated at publication

training_window: not applicable: human-researched process; no model is trained or registered.

unit_sizing.basis: flat 0.25 units per play, recorded; no variable sizing

untouched_test_window: not applicable: no model is registered. The 2025 NFL holdout remains unspent.
